title: SLE distance estimate with epsilon-power bound for kappa<8
statement_scope: For every $\kappa<8$ and $\delta>0$ there is $0<c<\infty$ such that for all $\delta\le x<y\le 1/\delta$ and $0<\varepsilon<(y-x)/10$, $E[\Phi^b; \operatorname{dist}(\{x,y\},\gamma)<\varepsilon]\le c\,\varepsilon^{6a-1}$, where $\Phi=H_D(x,y)/H_{\mathbb H}(x,y)$ and $b=(3a-1)/2$.

proof_spans.label: full estimate via Loewner, Girsanov, time change, martingale and Bessel comparison
